title: apricity-daw rack.rs: pad layout and one sampler per pad from a resolved kit
description:
## Intent

Write the drum rack preset from a resolved kit.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/rack.rs`: `pub fn kit_preset(kit: &KitInfo, timeline: &Timeline, clips: &ClipSet, out: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>, DawError>`.
- Pad layout (`crates/apricity-daw/src/pads.rs`): sliced pad n on note 35 + n; drum words on the table in `design/daw-presets.md`; other names on free notes from C1 upward, alphabetically; more than 92 pads is an error naming the kit.
- Per pad: a branch named after the pad, receiving its note; a sampler with the sample file reference, start/end in frames at the file's own rate, volume from the pad's level gain, detune from `tuning_cents`, root key from the pad's root, transpose 0, classic mode, loop off, the velocity setting chosen in M0.
- Element names and encodings exactly as the M0 reference files show; a unit test compares our minimal preset's element tree with `tests/fixtures/reference/minimal-kit.adg` (structure, not values).

## Out of scope

Warp markers (next task), MIDI (M2), CLI (later task).

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw
```
The pad layout, region and level scenarios of `features/daw/kit-preset.feature` pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): write a kit as a drum rack preset`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the specs task and the resolved-kits task.
